# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend support** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback. The release advances to Skia m152, adds Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, and fixes native resource lifetimes. Nano Server can render explicitly loaded fonts, while shaping and data-copy paths allocate or copy less.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator 3.4.0** — Updates the bundled renderer and Vulkan allocator while retaining the allocator fallback needed by SkiaSharp callers. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808))

## API Surface

- **Graphite contexts and recording** — Adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, recorders, recordings, texture wrappers, and an image cache. Graphite follows an explicit record/snap/insert/submit model; existing Ganesh APIs remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral asynchronous pixel reads** — SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels provide callback-scoped results with copy-out helpers. Copy results before the callback returns; Ganesh completion requires submission and CheckAsyncWorkCompletion. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration** — The new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package supplies typed backend-context and extension helpers. GRVkExtensions gains a public constructor; the existing SharpVk package remains available. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Source owners stay alive for dependent views** — Region iterators retain their source region, and pixmap subsets and With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing premature finalization. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Native cleanup and failed readbacks corrected** — Releases the SkCachedData mutex guard before deletion and prevents Ganesh readbacks from returning stale data after failed flushes. Additional native font-rendering and Ganesh stability fixes are included. ([#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Owned buffers and streams released promptly** — Uniform Reset disposes its previous SKData; non-memory-backed ToHarfBuzzBlob streams are disposed by the blob release callback. Failed raster-image creation frees its allocated pixel buffer. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Faster streaming data output** — SKData.SaveTo writes native spans directly on span-capable targets, while older targets retain buffering. This removes an intermediate copy of each output chunk. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Less temporary text storage** — Font.Shape avoids copying an existing Feature array, and SKFourByteTag and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag formatting avoid char boxing. ([#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))
- **Lower object and text setup overhead** — Caches wrapper-registration reflection checks, pre-sizes uniform name lookups, and removes an intermediate string when encoding null-terminated text. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))

## Platform

- **Nano Server supports explicitly loaded fonts** — The FreeType-backed native variant renders fonts loaded from files, streams, or data. Its empty default font manager still provides no system fonts. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Native debugging assets** — Produces separate Apple native symbol packages with complete dSYMs while keeping customer packages symbol-free. Android libraries emit GNU build IDs that match their split-debug files. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Font.Shape avoids copying caller-owned Feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids char boxing. Apple native symbol packages and Android build IDs improve native diagnostics; bundled HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1.
